description: Break, solve and outsmart! A physics puzzle where logic matters most. The catapult is ready, the monsters are hiding, and one smart shot can start a full chain reaction. Tricky Traps is a bright physics puzzle built on logic, precision and satisfying destruction. If you enjoy brain games, catapult games and clever puzzle challenges, this quest is made for you. Puzzle levels with clever traps Sneaky monsters hide behind constructions full of traps, buttons, saws and moving parts. Your task is to read the scene, use logic and find the best way to solve each puzzle. Every level feels like a small test for fans of physics puzzle games, brain games and catapult games. Features: 👻 Monsters that challenge your thinking They bounce, tease and try to confuse you, but logic is stronger than chaos. Watch their behavior, aim carefully and find the right move. In these brain games, every monster becomes part of the puzzle. 🧩 Creative physics puzzle levels Explosive barrels, moving platforms, sharp traps and wild mechanisms make every level feel fresh. Some solutions look simple, while others need a smart chain reaction. These physics puzzle games reward careful thinking and creative timing. 🏹 Catapult action with smart decisions A well-aimed shot can break walls, push objects and trigger a chain reaction across the whole level. The catapult is more than a weapon — it is your main tool for solving each physics puzzle. That is what makes great catapult games so satisfying. ⚙️ Physics that reward logic Angle, force, momentum and timing all matter. You do not need formulas — just observe, think and act. Tricky Traps uses clear physics to make every puzzle feel fair, smart and fun. 🎮 Play offline anytime Enjoy quick sessions on the go or longer runs at home. Tricky Traps is perfect for fans of brain games, physics puzzle games and puzzle adventures that can be played anytime. The monsters are already nervous Tricky Traps blends physics puzzle challenges, playful chain reaction moments and the fun of catapult games into one bright puzzle quest.
